text:
Tomas Alvarez: Hey team :wave: I'm Tomas, starting today on Platform (CET). Laptop should arrive this afternoon. Two quick setup asks: who do I ping for access to the experiments/dev cluster and the model-registry? Also, is there a buddy assigned? Tiny fun fact: I own a terrible mug collection that I fully endorse.

OnboardingBot: Welcome to Redwood, Tomas Alvarez! MDM invite has been sent to tomas.alvarez@example.com. Please enroll your device and confirm in this thread once done. If you need manual enrollment, reply here and the team will assist.

Priya Rao: Welcome Tomas :tada: For model-registry access, tag me with your employee ID once MDM is finished. I'll add you to the registry-team. For the experiments/dev cluster, open an infra-access ticket and tag @IT Support.

Jordan Lee: Hi Tomas :wave: I'm Jordan  your buddy for weeks 1-4. Happy to pair on the first day walkthrough and help with dotfiles. We usually use zsh + a shared dotfiles starter in the repo. Coffee rec: local place on 3rd street does a mean flat white.

IT Support: Hi Tomas  after MDM enrollment we can provision cluster creds. Steps: enroll MDM, generate an ed25519 key locally, upload public key to https://id.redwood/internal-keys, then open a ticket with subject "cluster access request" and include your employee ID and team. Example commands:

```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "tomas@redwood"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
If you want the token for Docker registry as well, add "docker" in the ticket.

Marina Chen: Also FYI we have a new-hire intro circle at 15:00 CET today  it's short, 20m, and we'll introduce the teams. Tomas you're on the Platform intro list.

Tomas Alvarez: Thanks everyone! I haven't seen the MDM email yet (checked spam). My employee ID is E-66322. I love mugs too  currently a ceramic penguin that refuses to stay upright. :penguin:

Priya Rao: Got your employee ID. I'll queue the registry invite as soon as MDM is confirmed.

OnboardingBot: Manual resend triggered for MDM invite to tomas.alvarez@example.com. Please confirm if you still don't see it in 5 minutes.

Tomas Alvarez: Received the MDM link and started enrollment  looks good so far. One tiny follow-up: any preferred comment format for the SSH key?

Jordan Lee: We use comments like "tomas@redwood" for consistency, but it's not enforced. Also drop me a DM if you want my dotfiles or a quick screen share for the dev cluster.

IT Support: Confirmed MDM enrollment. Please upload the public key to the portal and then open the cluster access ticket. We'll approve within an hour after keys are visible.

Tomas Alvarez: Uploaded the pubkey and opened the ticket (ticket #4579). Thanks for the quick help! Also bringing the penguin mug to the intro circle if it behaves.

Marina Chen: :grin: Looking forward to meeting you, Tomas  welcome aboard!

Priya Rao: Added you to the model-registry team. You should have access in ~10 mins. Ping if anything is missing.

Tomas Alvarez: Access confirmed  everything looks good. Thanks for the warm welcome and speedy setup. See you at 15:00 CET!
